The secretary of agriculture shall 13 submit receipts for reimbursement to the director of the 14 department of administrative services. 15 EXPLANATION 16 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 17 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 18 This bill relates to the reimbursement of security expenses 19 for members of the general assembly and statewide elected 20 officials. The bill entitles the members of the general 21 assembly, governor, lieutenant governor, secretary of state, 22 auditor of state, treasurer of state, secretary of agriculture, 23 and attorney general to a one-time reimbursement of up to 24 $5,000 for the installation of a home security system and up 25 to $100 per month for the operation of a home security system. 26 The bill requires members of the general assembly and statewide 27 elected officials to submit receipts for reimbursement. 28 Pursuant to the Constitution of the State of Iowa, the 29 provision allowing members of the general assembly to receive 30 reimbursement applies upon the convening of the 92nd General 31 Assembly in January 2027. 32 -3- LSB 6653YC (1) 91 ss/ns 3/ 3
